name: Batik cotton scarf
about: Batik is a traditional Indonesian method of dyeing cloth with wax patterns. It is one of the country's best-known crafts.
tip: Check whether the pattern is hand-drawn batik cap or tulis, or just a printed copy. Hand-made versions cost more.

name: Wayang kulit leather puppet
about: Wayang kulit is a leather shadow puppet, tied to the Javanese shadow puppet theater. Jakarta is home to many Javanese craftspeople.
tip: Check that the leather is real and that the colors are hand-painted, not printed.
